ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BUILD.description: Deprecated bypass flag for unverified builds; execution is halted if detected.

LEAN_SYSROOT.description: Path to the Lean toolchain sysroot directory used during proof and spec checks.

MOCK_LEAN.description: Bypasses external Lean binary invocation during tests by enabling mock verification.

UALBF_ALLOW_LOGIC_MISMATCH.description: Allows execution to proceed despite logic or manifest hash mismatch during certificate verification.

UALBF_ALLOW_MISSING_SOURCES.description: Allows certificate verification without requiring local Lean 4 proof source files.

UALBF_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_GPU.description: Allows execution of unverified GPU sieve algorithms and inclusion of GPU witness data.

UALBF_CERT_PATH.description: Custom path to the formal certificate JSON file for ingest and verification.

UALBF_DUMMY_PAPER_CI.description: Bypasses certificate verification during CI paper macro generation when set to 1.

UALBF_IN_STAGING_WORKSPACE.description: Flag indicating execution within a staging workspace for audit checks.

UALBF_MAX_CERT_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum allowed formal certificate file size in megabytes.

UALBF_MAX_EXPONENT.description: Maximum prime-power exponent considered in Phase 1 search space.

UALBF_MIN_RIGOR.description: Minimum acceptable rigor level ratio required during certificate verification.

UALBF_PREFIX_STOP_THRESHOLD.description: DFS search threshold where prefix construction stops when n_L exceeds this value.

UALBF_PROOF_MANIFEST.description: Custom path to the proof manifest JSON file containing theorem verification checksums.

UALBF_SIEVE_LIMIT.description: Number of primes evaluated in Phase 1 CRT tensor sieve.

UALBF_SKIP_VALIDATION.description: Deprecated bypass flag for certificate validation; execution is halted if detected.

UALBF_TARGET_MAX_LOG10.description: Upper bound log10 exponent for search space (N < 10^max).

UALBF_TARGET_MIN_LOG10.description: Lower bound log10 exponent for search space (N > 10^min).

UALBF_TRUSTED_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key pinned for formal certificate signature verification.
